row:
Welcome to PONY Magazine – the ultimate channel for pony-mad riders! 🐴✨

From riding tips and stable hacks to fun pony challenges and behind-the-scenes adventures, we bring the magazine you love to life on screen. Whether you’re learning new skills, caring for your pony, or just want to enjoy all things equestrian, you’ll find loads of exciting videos right here.

📚 Inspired by the UK’s No.1 equestrian mag for young riders
🎥 Fun, friendly, and packed with pony content
💡 Learn, laugh, and love ponies with us every week!

Hit subscribe and join the pony-mad community today! 🐎💖

Head over to our website for more pony content including interactive quizzes, games, makes, riding advice and loads more! https://www.ponymag.com

Pick up a copy of PONY Magazine from your local newsagents or supermarket! Or, if you don't want to miss an issue, check out our current subscription offers here, https://www.ponymag.com/the-magazine/subscribe/
